mapper.select: SELECT id, template_id, user_id, agent_id, agent_name, agent_type, agent_desc, api_url, model_name, model_type, snapshot, create_time, update_time FROM ai_template WHERE template_id = #{templateId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, template_id, user_id, agent_id, agent_name, agent_type, agent_desc, api_url, model_name, model_type, snapshot, create_time, update_time FROM ai_template WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, template_id, user_id, agent_id, agent_name, agent_type, agent_desc, api_url, model_name, model_type, snapshot, create_time, update_time FROM ai_template WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_template (template_id, user_id, agent_id, agent_name, agent_type, agent_desc, api_url, model_name, model_type, snapshot) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{agentType}, #{agentDesc}, #{apiUrl}, #{modelName}, #{modelType}, #{snapshot})
